name: mcp-host-web-app
description: MCP host with pluggable connectors, OAuth, and a chat UI

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d
scripts.backend:dev: cd apps/host-backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.backend:migrate: cd apps/host-backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:sql: cd apps/host-backend && uv run python scripts/sql.py
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it mcp-host-postgres psql -U mcphost -d mcphost
scripts.mcp:public-tools: cd apps/mcp-servers/public-tools && uv run python src/server.py
